title: Connect steps with a pipe
summary: The pipe operator joins runnables in order. The output of the first becomes the input of the next.
introduction: The pipe operator joins runnables in order. The output of the first becomes the input of the next. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain connect steps with a pipe
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The pipe operator joins runnables in order. The output of the first becomes the input of the next.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda
clean = RunnableLambda(lambda text: text.strip())
upper = RunnableLambda(lambda text: text.upper())
chain = clean | upper
print(chain.invoke("  Moon  "))
blocks.title: Connect steps with a pipe

blocks.text: The output is MOON. The first step removes surrounding spaces. The second changes letters to uppercase. The types match because both steps use text.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Replace upper with a step that adds an exclamation mark.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Check that the next step accepts the type produced by the previous one.
